seo_title: Server-Side SEO Attribution: Recover B2B Sales
seo_desc: Stop payment gateways from breaking your SEO analytics. We implement Server-Side attribution in your root directory to track 100% of the B2B funnel.
author_pitch: As a developer, I know that solid code in the root directory is the foundation of everything. If your payment gateway cuts off your customer's trail, you are flying blind. We design server-level solutions so your SEO and your revenue match perfectly.
title: Server-Side SEO Attribution: Protect Your Organic ROI in Payment Gateways
body:
Do you lose track of your B2B clients just as they are about to pay?

Attracting qualified organic traffic takes months of work. However, many SMEs and B2B businesses see their conversions classified as "Direct Traffic" or "Referral" from the payment gateway itself. This technical bottleneck prevents you from measuring the real return on your positioning strategy, leaving you without data to scale the transactional keywords that actually generate revenue.

The trap of Client-Side analytics

Relying exclusively on browser pixels or basic frontend integrations causes ad blockers and third-party redirects to destroy session continuity. If your analytics do not dominate the backend, your SEO budget evaporates blindly.

Our solution: Root-Level Server-Side Attribution

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we solve this block from the foundation of your server. We integrate a middleware in your root directory that captures and persists the initial SEO parameters, connecting them securely and directly with your production payment gateway webhooks.

  1. Session persistence: We save the organic origin in temporary databases before the checkout.
  2. Webhook synchronization: We capture the gateway confirmation and link it to the original SEO lead.
  3. Immunity to AdBlockers: By processing in the backend, conversion data is never blocked by the browser.
  4. Funnel cleanup: We eliminate false referrals so your dashboard reflects only real acquisition channels.

The Real Impact on your B2B Analytics

  • 100% reliable metrics: Discover which articles and transactional pages generate real income.
  • Secure scalability: Invest in SEO with the guarantee of measuring the exact ROI of each campaign.
  • Total data control: Keep confidential information on your own server, strictly complying with privacy regulations.
